split.method: dev if int(sha256(seed + '|' + corpus + '|' + flag_id)[:8], 16) % 2 == 0, else heldout
split.note: The split is computed from the committed flag id, so a reader can recompute it without the labels.

anchor.terms: public repository, Apache-2.0; pointers, flag ids and labels only; evidence text is not committed

program-examples.terms: public repository, MIT; pointers, flag ids and labels only; evidence text is not committed

litesvm.terms: public repository, Apache-2.0; pointers, flag ids and labels only; evidence text is not committed

solana-program-library.terms: public repository, Apache-2.0; pointers, flag ids and labels only; evidence text is not committed

excluded.coral-xyz/sealevel-attacks: no test suite the tool recognizes (only tests/raw.ts, which does not drive a recognized harness)
excluded.neodyme-labs/neodyme-breakpoint-workshop: the PoCs are binaries in pocs/src/bin, not test functions; the tool reads tests
excluded.neodyme-labs/solana-ctf: no LICENSE file at the pinned commit; excluded on terms even though the tool found six flags

population: public Rust and Anchor TypeScript test suites. This is not a corpus of judged PoCs or incident reproductions; the report must say so and must not present the result as PoC precision.
cap_note: At most 30 flags per rule per corpus are labelled, drawn by sha256(seed + ':' + flag_id). A rule with 30 or fewer flags on a corpus is labelled in full.
